name: Smoky Cod with Crispy Bread Crumbs, Potatoes, Broccoli & Lemon Aioli

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg new potatoes
6 crowns broccoli
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Halve new potatoes. Divide between two large baking sheet pans, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper
garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until potatoes start to soften, 15-18 minutes.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a large bowl along with oil, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo and spices in a small bowl, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
mayonnaise
¾ tsp smoked paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat the cod dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Spread the mayo mixture over top side of the fish, then sprinkle with bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere. (Reserve bowl for later use.)

When the potatoes have started to soften, remove from oven. Add broccoli to the baking sheets, toss to combine, and spread back out in an even layer. Add breaded fish to the baking sheets, nestling it into the veggies.
Return baking sheets to the oven; continue to roast until the fish is cooked through and veggies are fork-tender, 12-15 minutes more. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemons into the reserved bowl. Add mayo and spices, then stir to combine the lemon-pepper aioli.
instructions.secondary_message:
mayonnaise
black pepper
salt
garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Divide cod, potato, and broccoli between plates. Serve with lemon-pepper aioli on the side and enjoy!
